title: Techcombank Ho Chi Minh City International Marathon 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
meta_description: Techcombank Ho Chi Minh City International Marathon review: 23,000 runners on 7 December 2025, registrations up 28%, and an Ethiopian sweep in the men's marathon.
dek: Ho Chi Minh City's Techcombank marathon drew 23,000 runners for its eighth edition in December 2025. Here is what that edition was like, ahead of the ninth.
verdict: The Techcombank Ho Chi Minh City International Marathon is a big and still-growing race. The eighth edition, on 7 December 2025, drew 23,000 runners, with registrations up about 28% on the year before [1]. Ethiopian elites swept the men's marathon podium [1]. The city's tourism department called it one of Ho Chi Minh City's most distinctive sports-tourism events [1]. If you want a big December marathon in southern Vietnam with an international elite field, it is a strong choice. The available account is a sponsor's press release, so treat it as a summary of scale rather than a review of the race.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: The eighth edition was run on Sunday 7 December 2025 and attracted 23,000 runners [1]. According to the organisers, registrations were up about 28% on 2024, part of a multi-year trend of growth [1].
A marathon expo ran from 5 December [1].

sections.heading: The Front of the Race
paragraphs: Ethiopian elite runners swept the men's marathon podium [1]. The sponsor, Xtep, said its athletes won six gold medals across the categories [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a large, growing marathon in Ho Chi Minh City. Registrations have risen year after year, so enter early for the ninth edition.
Plan for heat. Even in December, Ho Chi Minh City is warm and humid on race morning.
This review is compiled from a sponsor's press release on the 2025 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran the Techcombank Ho Chi Minh City International Marathon in 2025?
faqs.answer: 23,000 runners took part in the eighth edition on 7 December 2025. Registrations were up about 28% on 2024, continuing several years of growth.

faqs.question: Who won the Techcombank HCMC Marathon in 2025?
faqs.answer: Ethiopian elite runners swept the men's marathon podium. The race's apparel sponsor, Xtep, said its sponsored athletes won six golds, two silvers and two bronzes across the categories.

faqs.question: When is the Techcombank Ho Chi Minh City International Marathon?
faqs.answer: In early December. The 2025 race, the eighth, was on 7 December, and the ninth is scheduled for December 2026. A marathon expo runs in the days before the race.

editorial_notes: Rewritten 2026-09-28 about the previous edition (7 December 2025). Replaces a pre-race preview. The only readable source is a sponsor's press release; the men's winners' names did not survive in the readable text, so they are not given. No rating.
